notes.title: AMUSEMENT PARK EVENT AND VER 2.3.3.1 RELEASE!
notes.notes:
"Release some stress and join the Girls for a jolly trip to the Fun Park. These wild rides are for adults only!

[b]Event Details[/b]
-Brand new Unlock Animation with Leoni
-New sexy threads for Shreya and Thida
-Collect Ride Tickets (Germany, Thailand, and India) and Cotton Candy (everywhere except Germany, Thailand and India)
-Play the event mission to get more event items (opens after the first level-up, only once)

►  Fixed crash when a big amount of dollars was given as an outfit collection or a mission reward

notes.title: Version 2.2.9.2 is now released!!
notes.notes:
Hi Playductionites,

We’ve just released a new build that’s fixed some of the big issues with the previous build from reports made especially over the weekend.
Thanks once again for the feedback to help make our game better. Below are the details of the new build.

Changelog
► Players can now ignore tutorial and head directly to the welcome back window
► Fixed broken hiring screen for CDG route
► Restored standby item effectiveness for Event Messenger threads

notes.title: VERSION 2.2.3.0 is out!!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,
we just released a new Sexy Airlines build (v2.2.3.0) and here are the changes:

  ► Added missing loca to distinguish champions leaderboards in login rewards popup
  ► Show mission reward in main UI again
   - Also improved texts/rewards icons display according to the device resolution
  ► Context-Sensitive Profile Pic in Idle Panel Screen
  ► Grant players in SA an item if they play SSA
  ► Mark locked airports with a symbol
  ► Fixed an issue with the claiming of leaderboard rewards
  ► Added a permanent outfits collection for VIP costumes (access from any FA profile that has a VIP outfit)
  ► Added an additional max luggage and max message increase to the shop
